Title: Seafoam Agate Tray
Body (HTML):
A slice of agate in resin. Fine rays of teal, sea green and soft gold burst outward from a frosty white centre filled with sparkling silver crushed glass, and the whole tray is finished with a gleaming silver-leaf edge.

Lovely on a dresser or coffee table for rings, keys or a candle in its own glass, or simply propped up to catch the light. The crushed glass centre has texture, so it isn't meant for food.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Midnight Marble Thinkers — Pair
Body (HTML):
Two little seated thinkers, side by side, cast in swirls of indigo, blue and milky white with a flash of magenta. One rests a chin on a hand, the other leans into a knee: a quiet pair for a bookshelf, desk or windowsill.

Every pour marbles differently, so no two pairs are alike.

Title: Ocean Cube Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A chunky little cube of deep ocean blue, swirled through with cloudy white like waves rolling over each other. Light glows right through the sides.

The round well takes a flameless tealight, or a real tealight in its own little glass cup, which keeps the heat off the resin. It's just as nice holding rings or earrings by the bed.
